verdict.rationale: Square documents the building blocks an agent would need. There are webhook subscriptions and verification, a Payments API with card-on-file sources for re-charging, idempotency keys for safe retries, and Invoices and Subscriptions APIs. An official MCP server also exposes payments, invoices and customers to agents. However, no evidence shows failed-payment-specific events, built-in retry schedules, or dunning outreach, so the agent would have to assemble this workflow itself. Missing for 10: documented payment-failure webhook events, a native smart-retry or dunning feature, automated failed-payment customer outreach, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
